Installations.Purpose: A communal working forge near the well, usable for the same forge verbs (batch forging, re-forge, temper, mineral infusion, cold-work processes on released goods) as the Sill and Cinderhold forges, so the town has a place to work.
Installations.Alternative: A single weapon can be assembled from the pack anywhere; carried components, the Sill and Cinderhold forges and buying assembled weapons remain, and nothing requires this forge.
Installations.Basis: Convenience, not a gap: surface villagers own and run forges (faction row, mw/lore.md section 5). Placed on the owner's standing instruction to put machines in every town; the placement plan and its critique prefer test-only rows for towns without a local problem, recorded in Docs/MACHINE-INSTALLATIONS.md. Delete the row to revert before release.
